# Next Alert

Next Collection family of 10 current-generation alert, toast and announcement designs with success, warning, danger, info and neutral states, in four directions: motion (toast with a travelling border beam, critical banner with a breathing glow ring, announcement ticker that stops on hover, focus and reduced motion), depth (report rows as a 3D toast stack that fans out, floating glass alert with light edge and depth shadow), bold (neo-brutalism, claymorphism, animated hazard stripes) and smart layout (one-line alert that expands with details and summary, adaptive alert that container queries turn into an inline bar, a card or an icon chip). Follows the inline alert and toast patterns of Universal Theme, Sonner and Magic UI: state is always shown by semantic color plus an icon and a text label. CSS only, no JavaScript. The border beam adapts the Magic UI border-beam design.

|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |

| Modes | partial (single / report column), report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.0 |
| Based on | [Magic UI](https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui) (MIT) |

Pick a Style for the region. Map State to a column or static value returning success, warning, danger, info or neutral; any other value renders as neutral. Danger alerts use role=alert, all others role=status. Icon defaults to a state icon when left empty. The link renders only when both Link URL and Link Label are set. In report mode Stacked Toasts shows the first three rows as a stack that fans out on hover, keyboard focus or touch devices.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | Style | selectList (`beamToast`, `pulseCritical`, `tickerBar`, `stackedToasts`, `liftGlass`, `neoBrutal`, `clay`, `hazardStripe`, `expandDetails`, `adaptiveBar`) | yes | `beamToast` | Visual design of the alert, each followed by its Next Collection direction. Beam Toast, motion: floating toast with a light beam travelling around its border. Pulse Critical, motion: banner whose icon and outline breathe with a glow ring, meant for danger. Ticker Bar, motion: one-line announcement bar whose text scrolls as a marquee, stopping on hover and focus. Stacked Toasts, depth: report rows become a 3D stack of toasts that fans out on hover or focus; a single alert shows two cards behind it. Lift Glass, depth: floating frosted glass alert with a light edge and depth shadow. Neo Brutal, bold: ink border, hard offset shadow and a state sticker. Clay, bold: soft pillowy claymorphism surface. Hazard Stripe, bold: warning tape with moving diagonal stripes. Expand Details, smart: compact one-line alert that expands to show message and link. Adaptive Bar, smart: an inline bar when wide, a card when medium and an icon chip when narrow. |
| `state` | State | sessionStateValue |  |  | success, warning, danger, info or neutral. Any other or empty value renders as neutral. Danger alerts are announced immediately with role=alert. |
| `title` | Title | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Short headline, for example Invoice INV-2041 is overdue. In Expand Details it is the always-visible summary line. |
| `message` | Message | sessionStateValue |  |  | Supporting sentence that says what happened and what to do next. In Ticker Bar it scrolls after the title; in Expand Details it shows when expanded. |
| `icon` | Icon | sessionStateValue |  |  | Font APEX icon class, for example fa-truck. Leave empty to use the state icon: check for success, triangle for warning, cross for danger, info for info, bell for neutral. |
| `meta` | Meta Text | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional small text such as a time stamp, for example 2 min ago. Format dates in SQL with the application's NLS settings. |
| `linkUrl` | Link URL | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional target, for example f?p=&APP_ID.:20:&SESSION.::NO::P20_ID:&P10_ID. or a column holding apex_page.get_url. Must be developer-controlled, never end-user input. |
| `linkLabel` | Link Label | sessionStateValue |  |  | Visible link text, for example Review invoice. The link renders only when both Link URL and Link Label are set. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/next-alert/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_next_alert.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
